source_document: official NBA gamebook PDFs (one per game), SCORE BY PERIOD and team box totals; tip times from the August schedule PDF (2026-27-NBA-Regular-Season-Schedule-By-Date.pdf rows 236-244) cross-checked against each game page
source_document_header: Sunday, November 15, 2026 gamebooks, statsdmz.nba.com/pdfs/20261115/ (chunk 0 of each gamebook)
extraction_tool: Arena fetch_page over statsdmz gamebook PDFs (chunk 0 = full box score + SCORE BY PERIOD + inactives) with manual transcript; no reconstruction
row_format: [game_id, date, tip_et, arena, city, away_abbr, home_abbr, away_q(list of printed periods 1-4), away_final, home_q(list of printed periods 1-4), home_final, winner_abbr, loser_abbr, source_url, away_ot_periods(list of printed OT period scores), home_ot_periods]

verification.quarter_sum_rule: For each team line, the sum of the printed period scores (quarters 1-4 plus any printed overtime periods) must equal the printed final. Overtime is never reconstructed: the OT period score is printed in the gamebook's SCORE BY PERIOD table and is copied as printed. If a printed quarter score is missing, the row is published unchecked and no quarter is inferred.
